reason: A web browsing plugin that opens URLs and searches in new tabs, with DshDesktop-specific web tabs, injected navigation controls, selection search, and configurable search settings.

summaries.zh: 提供网页浏览与搜索功能，可在 DshDesktop 或通用浏览器中新建标签页打开网址，并支持搜索设置。
summaries.en: Provides web browsing and search features by opening URLs in new tabs in DshDesktop or compatible browsers, with configurable search settings.

capabilities: Opens URLs in desktop or browser tabs
Searches entered text or selected webpage text using configured engines
Injects a WebView2 extension toolbar into desktop web tabs
Communicates browsing commands and settings with the DshDesktop host
